title: Preparing Interview Questions
writingModel: Interview Questions for Professor Sultanova — prepared by Kamila Seitkali

Context: I am preparing to interview Professor Sultanova about her career in bilingual linguistics research. I want to use indirect questions to be polite and professional, and tag questions where appropriate to show interest and invite elaboration.

Could you tell me how long you have been working in the field of bilingualism? // I'd like to know what first inspired you to specialise in language acquisition. // You've been based at WKU for several years, haven't you? // Do you know whether the department has always focused on Kazakh-Russian bilingualism, or whether this developed over time?

Could you explain what your current research project involves? // I'd like to know how you select participants for your studies. // The research has produced some interesting results, hasn't it? // Do you happen to know whether your findings have influenced educational policy in Kazakhstan?

Could you tell me what the most surprising finding in your career has been? // I wonder whether you have conducted research in any countries outside Kazakhstan. // You speak at least three languages, don't you? // I'd like to know whether you find it easier to communicate about linguistics in Kazakh, Russian, or English.

Could you tell me what advice you would give to a student beginning a career in linguistics research? // Do you know whether WKU plans to expand its linguistics research programme in the next few years? // You believe the future of language education looks promising, don't you? // I'd like to know what you think the most important challenge will be for researchers in this field.
